g.text: FT232RL ISP programmer + AT89S52 minimal system

g.desc: FT232RL ISP programmer + AT89S52 minimal system

g.text: EA/VPP (pin 31) must be tied to VCC. C6 + R1 are the power-on reset (the programmer overrides them).

g.desc: EA/VPP (pin 31) must be tied to VCC. C6 + R1 are the power-on reset (the programmer overrides them).

g.text: RST is active HIGH. SCK must stay below f(XTAL)/16 (12 MHz -> below 750 kHz).

g.desc: RST is active HIGH. SCK must stay below f(XTAL)/16 (12 MHz -> below 750 kHz).

g.text: FT232RL bit-bang pins: TXD = SCK, RXD = MOSI, RTS# = MISO (input), CTS# = RST.

g.desc: FT232RL bit-bang pins: TXD = SCK, RXD = MOSI, RTS# = MISO (input), CTS# = RST.

g.text: The target is powered from J3 (5 V); the FT232RL module only shares GND.

g.desc: The target is powered from J3 (5 V); the FT232RL module only shares GND.
